tina_cs: quick flag 1:30am UTC 174888123434 - noticed a cluster of accounts moved from HEALTH=green to HEALTH=amber after the scoring push last night. lots of "onboard_status: stalled" and low "recent_usage_minutes". anyone touch the healthscorer model or playbook weights?

omar_platform: i deployed score_v3 at 02:12 UTC to include the new product-usage signal. rollout was gradual (5% to 100%) but we didn't change the onboarding step weights.

lucy_data: i ran a quick comparison between score_v2 and score_v3 on the last 7 days. summary: median health delta = -12, but the drop concentrates in accounts with sparse event windows (last_event > 30d). i think the new usage decay params are too aggressive.

vincent_sre: recommend a fast rollback to v2 for safety, then we can iterate. we should also create a compensating job to restore any derived fields that were stomped.

omar_platform: i can roll back to v2 in 10m. but can we do a partial rollback (only decay param) instead of full revert?

lucy_data: partial rollback makes sense. specifically revert: `usage_decay_half_life = 14d` back to `30d`. see my quick test below (sample of 1k accounts):

```sql
-- sample comparison
SELECT account_id, health_v2, health_v3, last_event_days
FROM health_compare
WHERE last_event_days > 30
ORDER BY health_v2 - health_v3 DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

lucy_data: results show top 20 accounts dropped > 25 points on v3. many are high ARR.

vincent_sre: if high-ARR accounts are affected we can't wait. rollback + patch is my vote. also add a pre-deploy check for top-N ARR impact for future releases.

omar_platform: starting partial rollback now. will toggle `usage_decay_half_life` feature flag to previous value and redeploy scorer component. tagging ops-bot to create rollback incident ticket.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20231124-4512. Rollback job queued: scorer-revert-1748881234. Logs will stream to /var/logs/healthscorer/rollbacks/1748881234.log

omar_platform: rollback applied. healthscorer service restarted. running delta job to recalc health for affected accounts.

lucy_data: running recalculation script now. ETA ~18m. SQL job id: recalc_1748881234_a. i'm producing a CSV of accounts with delta > 10 to hand to cs for outreach.

ops-bot: Recalc job started: recalc_1748881234_a. Progress: 0% -> 4% -> 18% (updates every 2m).

vincent_sre: good work. once CSV is ready add a reason column so CS can explain the change to customers: e.g., "health recalculated due to scorer parameter rollback (usage_decay)".

tina_cs: please include contact owner and renewal_date in CSV. we need to prioritize outreach for renewals in the next 60 days.

lucy_data: adding fields now. query used to produce CSV:

```sql
SELECT a.account_id, a.owner, a.renewal_date, h_before, h_after, (h_after - h_before) AS delta, reason
FROM health_recalc_diff h
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = h.account_id
WHERE ABS(h_after - h_before) > 10
ORDER BY ABS(delta) DESC;
```

lucy_data: CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-cs/health-recalc/1748881234-delta.csv. affected_accounts=87, high_ARR_in_list=14, renewals_due_<=60d=9.

tina_cs: copying. i'll spin up an outreach queue for the 9 imminent renewals. @omar_platform please also add a post-mortem note about release gating for scoring changes.

omar_platform: note added to release: "add top-N ARR impact simulation and automatic canary hold if >5% of high-ARR accounts shift by >10 points". will PR the gating into the runner.

vincent_sre: also create a monitoring alert: when median health delta across a run crosses 7 points, pause rollout and notify product + cs. i can add that to the alerting playbook.

tina_cs: next steps summarized: 1) outreach queue for 9 renewals (tina_cs); 2) post-mortem + release gating PR (omar_platform); 3) add monitoring alert (vincent_sre); 4) validated CSV in s3 (lucy_data). thanks team :raised_hands:
